🔥 ai-file-sorter | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically organize and rename files on a user's computer using AI, reducing clutter and improving file discoverability.
✨ Key Features: • Content-aware file organization and renaming • Supports local and remote LLMs • Preview-based workflows for user-controlled changes • Analyzes image content, document text, and media metadata
📖 Summary: AI File Sorter is a cross-platform desktop application designed to intelligently organize and rename files using AI. It supports local and remote LLMs, analyzes various file types including images, documents, audio, and video, and offers a preview-based workflow for user-controlled changes, ensuring privacy by design.
